import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

# clean
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for coll in (bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.curves, bpy.data.cameras, bpy.data.lights):
    pass

# materials
def mat(name, color, rough=0.28, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes=True
    bsdf=m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*color,1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=rough
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=metal
    if "Specular IOR Level" in bsdf.inputs:
        bsdf.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value=0.5
    return m

YELLOW=mat("YellowPlastic",(1.0,0.82,0.02),0.22)
YELLOW2=mat("Yellow2",(1.0,0.85,0.08),0.25)
BLACK=mat("BlackPlastic",(0.02,0.02,0.02),0.28)
BLACK_MATTE=mat("BlackMatte",(0.05,0.05,0.05),0.55)
WHITE=mat("White",(0.97,0.97,0.95),0.25)
DARKGREY=mat("DarkGrey",(0.15,0.13,0.10),0.35,0.3)
CHROME=mat("ChromeRim",(0.45,0.38,0.25),0.25,0.6)

def assign(obj,m):
    if obj.data and hasattr(obj.data,"materials"):
        obj.data.materials.append(m)
    return obj

def spun(name, profile, material, segments=64):
    # profile list (r,z) from bottom center to top center
    verts=[]
    faces=[]
    # vertices rings
    ring_starts=[]
    for (r,z) in profile:
        ring_starts.append(len(verts))
        if r<1e-6:
            verts.append((0,0,z))
        else:
            for i in range(segments):
                a=2*math.pi*i/segments
                verts.append((r*math.cos(a), r*math.sin(a), z))
    # faces between rings
    for idx in range(len(profile)-1):
        r1,z1=profile[idx]; r2,z2=profile[idx+1]
        s1=ring_starts[idx]; s2=ring_starts[idx+1]
        if r1<1e-6 and r2>1e-6:
            for i in range(segments):
                faces.append((s1, s2+(i+1)%segments, s2+i))
        elif r2<1e-6 and r1>1e-6:
            for i in range(segments):
                faces.append((s1+i, s1+(i+1)%segments, s2))
        elif r1>1e-6 and r2>1e-6:
            for i in range(segments):
                j=(i+1)%segments
                faces.append((s1+i, s1+j, s2+j, s2+i))
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+"Mesh")
    mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces)
    mesh.update()
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    assign(obj,material)
    # smooth
    for p in mesh.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return obj

def add_cyl(name, loc, radius, depth, material, rot=(0,0,0), verts=48):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=verts, radius=radius, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; assign(o,material)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return o

def add_sphere(name, loc, scale, material):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=48, ring_count=32, radius=1.0, location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale; assign(o,material)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return o

def add_box(name, loc, scale, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale; assign(o,material)
    return o

def add_torus(name, loc, major, minor, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_segments=48, minor_segments=16, major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; assign(o,material)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return o

# --- BODY ---
# lower body spun
lower_profile=[(0,0.18),(0.75,0.18),(1.08,0.22),(1.24,0.38),(1.30,0.65),(1.26,1.05),(1.14,1.55),(1.06,1.82),(1.06,1.96),(0.95,1.99),(0,1.99)]

# head

head=spun("Head", head_profile, YELLOW)

# black gap between

# base black

add_cyl("BottomPlate",(0,0,0.06),1.02,0.10,BLACK_MATTE)

# top black disc
add_cyl("TopDisc",(0,0,3.18),0.96,0.07,BLACK)
# tiny ridge lines on top (thin boxes)
for i in range(5):
    add_box(f"TopLine{i}",(0,0.58-i*0.07,3.225),(0.65,0.015,0.008),BLACK_MATTE)

# --- FEET ---
def make_foot(side, name):
    x=1.02*side
    # sole black
    sole=add_sphere(name+"Sole",(x,-0.55,0.14),(0.48,1.0,0.16),BLACK)
    # deform sole taper front ( -Y is front/toe)
    # We'll keep sphere; toe at -Y
    foot=add_sphere(name,(x,-0.55,0.28),(0.46,0.98,0.30),YELLOW)
    # taper toe: modify vertices: for y<0 local, narrow x and lower z slightly?
    mesh=foot.data
    for v in mesh.vertices:
        # local coords radius 1 sphere; y -1 toe, +1 heel
        if v.co.y < -0.2:
            t=(-v.co.y-0.2)/0.8  # 0..1
            v.co.x *= (1-0.35*t)
            v.co.z *= (1-0.25*t)
        if v.co.z < -0.4:
            v.co.z = -0.4 + (v.co.z+0.4)*0.3  # flatten bottom
    mesh.update()
    # grooves near heel: two thin tori flattened around foot? use torus scaled
    for gi, gy in enumerate([0.22,0.32]):
        g=add_torus(name+f"Groove{gi}",(x,gy-0.55,0.30),0.40,0.012,YELLOW2,rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))
        g.scale=(1.05,0.55,1.0)
    return foot

make_foot(-1,"FootL")
make_foot(1,"FootR")

# --- SHOULDERS ---
for side, nm in [(-1,"ShoulderL"),(1,"ShoulderR")]:
    s=add_cyl(nm,(1.22*side,0,1.58),0.42,0.42,YELLOW,rot=(0,math.radians(90),0))

# --- CURVES for arms ---
def make_curve(name, points, bevel, material):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE')
    cu.dimensions='3D'
    cu.bevel_depth=bevel
    cu.bevel_resolution=4
    cu.fill_mode='FULL'
    sp=cu.splines.new('BEZIER')
    sp.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for i,p in enumerate(points):
        bp=sp.bezier_points[i]
        bp.co=p
        bp.handle_left_type='AUTO'
        bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cu)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    assign(ob,material)
    return ob

# Front is -Y. Viewer right in front view (camera at -Y looking +Y) : camera right is -X? Let's check: camera at (0,-8,2) looking to origin (+Y), up Z, right vector = view x up? Right = -X? Actually cross: forward +Y, up +Z, right = forward? Right-handed: right = ? For camera looking +Y, screen right is -X (because X east, looking north, east is right -> +X is right). def del_obj(name):
    o=bpy.data.objects.get(name)
    if o:
        bpy.data.objects.remove(o, do_unlink=True)

    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=0.32

def spun(name, profile, material, segments=64):
    verts=[]; faces=[]; starts=[]
    for (r,z) in profile:
        starts.append(len(verts))
        if r<1e-6: verts.append((0,0,z))
        else:
            for i in range(segments):
                a=2*math.pi*i/segments

    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+"Mesh"); mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); mesh.update()
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj); obj.data.materials.append(material)
    for p in mesh.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return obj
